goal: Prevent an assertion crash on startup during AssumeUTXO background validation
Stop nodes from entering an unbootable state when restarting with an unlinked snapshot block
Avoid requiring a full reindex to recover if node restarts during background sync
agreement: Strong support with no open objections
Verified fix and reproduced startup assertion when reverting changes (ValeraFinebits, Yudis-bit)
Question on null parent pointer was answered by the author (Yudis-bit)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it prevents an assertion crash loop on startup during AssumeUTXO sync
Without the fix, nodes restarting in this window become completely unbootable
Recovery requires a full reindex which wipes the snapshot chainstate
